flawless: My host flies in perfect formation. You never found a gap in it.
Not a feather singed. Return to Benalia and pray for a stronger hand.
The dawn is patient, and today it did not even need its patience.
solid: You wounded me, and every wound was healed by my next strike. Such is the dawn.
Brave, mortal. Brave enough that I will remember your name.
close: Serra's light, that was close! I have not been pressed so since the Phyrexian skies.
My wings are heavy and my host is scattered. You fought nobly.
